from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs/task-80392057.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and g[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)+1
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)+1
            colored=[(y,x) for y,x in cells if g[y][x] != 0]
            if not colored:
                continue
            pr0=min(y for y,x in colored); pr1=max(y for y,x in colored)+1
            pc0=min(x for y,x in colored); pc1=max(x for y,x in colored)+1
            pat=[row[pc0:pc1] for row in g[pr0:pr1]]
            for y in range(r0,r1):
                for x in range(c0,c1):
                    g[y][x]=pat[(y-pr0)%len(pat)][(x-pc0)%len(pat[0])]
    return g
'''
